THEARCHITECT-INSCRIPTION_POTION.title: Inscription Potion
THEARCHITECT-INSCRIPTION_POTION.descript: Enchant a card in your hand with Sharp {EnchantAmount} or Nimble {EnchantAmount} for this combat.
THEARCHITECT-REVISION_SOLVENT.title: Revision Solvent
THEARCHITECT-REVISION_SOLVENT.descriptio: Remove all Enchantments from up to 3 cards in your hand. For each affected card, draw {Cards} card(s) and gain {Block} Block.
THEARCHITECT-REPRISE_ELIXIR.title: Reprise Elixir
THEARCHITECT-REPRISE_ELIXIR.description: Choose a card in your hand. The next time you manually play it this turn, replay it {Replays} additional time(s).
THEARCHITECT-REPRISE_ELIXIR.selectionScr: Choose a card to replay this turn.
